blocks.html:
This method updates a shipping profile. It sends a request to the
[Update Shipping Profile](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#shipping-profiles\_postshippingprofilesid)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the shipping profile to update.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the shipping profile to update.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the shipping profile.

children.name: type
children.description: The type of the shipping profile.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the shipping profile.

types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the shipping profile.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.
